newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-ATLETICO HOLD AJAX TO 1-1 DRAW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO HOLD AJAX TO 1-1 DRAW.

text.p: Former holders Ajax Amsterdam were held to a 1-1 draw by Atletico Madrid in a European Cup quarter final first leg on Wednesday.
Ajax made the running in the opening minutes but conceded a goal from Argentine international Juan Esnaider in the eighth minute.
Delfi Geli broke down the right and flipped the ball across the Ajax defence for Esnaider to put Atletico in front with a straightforward header.

Ajax exposed the Atletico defence with surging runs from Marc Overmars down the left and darting attacks on the right by Nigerian international Tijani Babangida but had to wait until the second half for their equaliser.
Overmars and Finnish forward Jari Litmanen featured in a patient Ajax build-up which freed Patrick Kluivert to blast a shot low into the left-hand corner of the net.
Kluivert received his second booking of the competition in the first half after hotly disputing an offside decision and will miss the second leg in Madrid in two weeks.
